However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. The Engineer's Resume & The Service Pr ovider's details should be filled in the attached format. 2. The successful Service Provider must sign a Comprehensive Annual Mai

ntenance Contract (AMC) Agreement on a Rs. 500/- stamp paper. The co st of the stamp paper shall be borne by the Service Provider. 3. The nine Acer All-in-One desktop PCs purchased during Year 2023-24 s hall be included in the AMC after 24.03.2027 4. The Dell laptop purchased during Year 2023-24 shall be included in the AMC after 31.01.2027 5. The successful Service Provider shall submit a Bank Guarantee of 5% of the total AMC value as a security deposit, valid for 15 months. 6. The salary of the Resident Engineer shall be paid by the Service Provid er. 7. The Commissionerate Office reserves the right to remove any hardwar e, such as All-in-One desktops, scanners, printers, etc., from the Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC). 8. The Service Provider shall submit valid address proof and supporting d ocuments, such as PAN Card, Aadhaar Card, and GST Registration Certifi cate. 9. The service provider shall be responsible for shifting and installing com puters, printers, UPS systems, software, and other related IT equipment as per the requirements of the office . 6.
